description: This file contains the implementation of an Active Record pattern for database interaction within a PHP project, extending functionality similar to or superset of Zend Framework's Active Record. It defines classes for database connections, table metadata, and record handling including CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), caching mechanisms, and utility functions.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection and associated table metadata within the active record implementation.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Holds metadata about a database table, including its name, fields, keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Implements the Active Record pattern for database table rows, providing methods for CRUD operations, metadata management, and error handling.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with an internal tracker and returns its index.

methods.name: ADODB_Active_Record::__construct
methods.description: Initializes a new active record object for a specified table, optional primary keys, and database connection.

methods.name: ADODB_Active_Record::UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Refreshes or initializes the metadata about the associated database table, including cache handling.

methods.name: ADODB_Active_Record::Error
methods.description: Handles error reporting, optionally throwing or outputting error messages.

methods.name: ADODB_Active_Record::DB
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection associated with the active record.
